question: General docs search mixes unrelated pages. How do I restrict a quorum query to Stellar validator documentation?

golden.answer: Call search_docs_in_category with query quorum and category validators. The adapter keeps only hits under the /docs/validators path, because the docs search has no category facet; the result carries pathFiltered: true. Check the returned paths and snippets, then open the relevant page with get_doc_page. A soft-empty result means no candidate in the search window fell under that path, or no kept section contains a query term, so broaden once with search_docs. Use only the operation's supported category values.
keyFacts: Uses the validators category to constrain the quorum search.
Checks the returned paths and follows the relevant result for full content.
avoid: Do NOT invent a category outside the operation's supported vocabulary.
Do NOT claim an upstream search facet performed the category restriction.
golden.notes: Behavioral docs-category case; result ordering and content are live. Mintlify backend since 2026-11-02: hits carry url, path, title, optional section, and snippet; there are no breadcrumbs.

sources.note: Fetch-verified local path exists and defines the exercised contract/workflow.
